about: Findings of scripts/check-knip.mjs recorded at VIB-65, one group per kind and file, each with a reason. A finding not listed here fails CI, and an entry knip no longer finds fails too, so this file only shrinks. Regenerate the list with node scripts/check-knip.mjs --write-baseline, which keeps existing reasons; every new entry still needs one.

entries.reason: globals.css loads @vibtra/ui fonts and both @fontsource-variable packages with CSS @import; knip does not read CSS imports.

Recorded at the VIB-65 baseline: knip finds no import of stripe in guard-oss. The hosted billing code in ee/ (private guard repository) may load it through this package; check there before removing it.
Recorded at the VIB-65 baseline: no file in packages/ui imports @tanstack/react-table. Removing it changes the lockfile, so it is left to a follow-up.
Tailwind v4 runs through @tailwindcss/vite and the CSS @import in packages/ui/src/theme.css; knip does not read CSS imports.
scripts/og-card.mjs and scripts/verify-landing.mjs load playwright with require.resolve and a dynamic import of the resolved path, which knip cannot follow.
